method: built-in image_gen image edit, original artwork as reference, followed by JPEG resize/export with FFmpeg
english_prompt: Use case: text-localization. Edit the provided original YouTube mathematics thumbnail to English. Keep the original style, composition, colors, mathematical diagrams, graph geometry, axes, logo positions, and original Wolfram Mathematica logo/lettering. Translate every channel label "Математические Эксперименты" to "Math Experiments" in the same white bold two-line box, preserving its original red, orange or magenta background. No additional branding, no new decorations, no redesigned charts. All foreground copy must be clean fluent English. Output landscape 16:9 with no black letterboxing; if input has black outer bars, use only the existing 16:9 artwork between them and fill the canvas. Prefer 1280x720. Fit translated text in the original zones without overlap or clipping. Right red panel white text: "Part 2: Fibonacci Numbers"; bullets ":= and =, Memoization"; "Generating Functions"; "Tiling a Rectangle with Squares"; "Regression (aka Fitting)"; "Solving Recurrences". Preserve continued fraction, color plot and rectangle tiling graphics.
review: Visually inspected for English copy, layout, branding and readable mathematical notation. Raster artwork may differ in fine details from the original.
